value.summary: Roadmap 001 s09: `pij directory` shows each role's holders, waiting requests, latest output and memory freshness, and prompts the prime with runnable next actions, including needs-based prompts (PEC, C18, C26).

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Delivers req-12, req-24 and the s09 part of req-27; req-14's prompts landed in s03. Depends on s05 (waiting requests), s06 (latest outputs) and s07 (memory freshness). Wording is PEC (C26): the prime and humans build whatever community the work needs now and reshape it as the work changes; templates are examples (C18).

sections.name: goals
value: Roadmap 001 s09: `pij directory` shows each role's holders, waiting requests, latest output and memory freshness, and prompts the prime with runnable next actions, including needs-based prompts (PEC, C18, C26).

sections.name: non_goals
value: Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

value.claim: Picture. `pij directory` shows, per role: holders, waiting requests (s05), latest output (s06) and memory freshness (s07).

Prompts (req-12). Each condition prints its runnable command: no live holder with requests waiting; two live holders on a one-holder role; memory not updated across recent closes; a recommended role missing.

Needs (req-24, req-27). A roadmap step's `needs: role:<id>` with no such role shows a prompt to create it from a template or as a new definition; the prime is also prompted to notice a need no role covers, in the PEC wording.
F21 (low, s03 dogfood): the view names the project's designated prime (the seat the project records as prime), so a missing `prime` role document doesn't read like a missing prime.

F22 (low, s03 dogfood): view polish. Holder times show local time with zone (the writer's zoned dates come from plan 206's F13), and a many-holder role's row wraps to one line per holder instead of one very long line.
Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). The view reads documents in-process and the store; it launches nothing. No timer or poll.

Docs and states. In this PR: roadmap s09 goes to complete (plan cell docs/plans/203-prime-prompts); req-12 and req-24 go to shipped; req-27 goes to in-progress (s10 finishes it); c-orient goes to shipped. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Code to read first: the s04 view (crates/daemon/src/community/, `pij directory`), s03's prompts (plan 194), roadmap docs (needs cells). No migration expected.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
